name: Pancetta
siboNotes: Plain pancetta is naturally FODMAP-free, but check for added seasonings containing garlic or onion. High fat content may trigger symptoms in some sensitive individuals.
preparationTips: Crisp in a dry pan without oil - pancetta renders its own fat
Check ingredient labels for garlic or onion powder which would make it high FODMAP
Use rendered fat for cooking other low-FODMAP vegetables
Remove excess fat if you're sensitive to high-fat foods
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in B vitamins, especially B12
